reproduction_target: Computational differential-expression analysis of mitochondria-associated sense and antisense transcripts in P. falciparum patient samples: (1) consolidation of a mitochondrial gene set via multi-tool localization prediction (TargetP/Cello2GO/MitoFate/PFMpred + PlasmoDB), (2) custom 8x60K microarray feature extraction (Agilent Feature Extraction), (3) microarray normalization + differential expression (Agilent GeneSpring GX; 75th-percentile shift, 40% detection filter, Pearson >=0.8, log2FC +/-0.8), (4) strand-specific RNA-seq alignment (HISAT2 vs GRCh38.p13 then P. falciparum 3D7), (5) differential expression (R package DESeq, size-factor normalization, log2FC +/-0.8), (6) GO functional enrichment (DAVID v6.8). Wet-lab sample processing, microarray hybridization, and RNA-seq library prep/sequencing are W-layer (out of computational-reproduction scope).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the biorxiv JATS Materials and Methods prose (source XML fetched via curl; WebFetch was 403-blocked). No code/software availability statement exists and no author script repository is named. DAVID and the four localization predictors are hosted web services; the two Agilent tools (Feature Extraction, GeneSpring GX) are proprietary commercial GUI software. HISAT2 and DESeq are open tools but carry no version pins in prose. Wet-lab steps counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: Mitochondrial gene-set consolidation via multi-tool localization prediction (TargetP, Cello2GO, MitoFate, PFMpred + PlasmoDBv57), consensus of >=2 tools plus literature validation - no versions for predictors
Microarray raw-image feature extraction (Agilent Feature Extraction software, 2-fold-above-background) - proprietary GUI, no version
Microarray normalization + differential expression (Agilent GeneSpring GX; 75th-percentile shift, >=40% detection filter, Pearson r>=0.8, log2FC +/-0.8) - proprietary GUI, no version
Strand-specific RNA-seq alignment (HISAT2 vs Homo sapiens GRCh38.p13, then unaligned reads vs P. falciparum 3D7; R1 vs mRNA, R2 vs reverse-complement; <Q30 filtering) - no version, no command line
Differential gene expression (R package DESeq; size-factor library normalization, log2FC cutoff +/-0.8) - no version
GO functional enrichment (DAVID v6.8, EASE score p<0.05, custom mitochondrial background list) - version pinned but closed hosted web service, no scriptable/snapshot path

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: No computational step reaches an RI ceiling. All 6 C-layer steps cap at NI: five tools carry no version pin at all (localization predictors, Agilent Feature Extraction, Agilent GeneSpring GX, HISAT2, DESeq) and the one version-pinned tool (DAVID v6.8) is a closed hosted web service with code axis 0 (no scriptable/snapshot reproduction path). No code/software availability statement, no author scripts, no env lockfile or container claimed; capture_claim=none, so no step could exceed RI even at stage2 and none reaches it here.

gaps.missing: No author analysis scripts or pipeline repository (GitHub/GitLab/Zenodo) are provided or named. Microarray filtering thresholds, HISAT2 two-level alignment logic, and DESeq DE were run without any published code, so exact reproduction of the analysis steps is not possible from prose alone.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the analysis scripts / notebooks (array filtering, HISAT2 alignment commands, DESeq DE) in a version-tagged public repository.
